defects.title: Browser task terminal event could leave a stale generic approval
defects.resolution: Track the generic approval inbox IDs independently while BrowserTaskService remains the execution source of truth, then clear the index on action and task terminal events.

defects.title: Renderer exposed capability-gated controls before the platform descriptor loaded
defects.resolution: Require capability === true for sensitive renderer entry points, hide Settings integrations consistently and return to General if an active pane becomes unavailable.

defects.title: Sidebar group labels failed WCAG AA color contrast
defects.resolution: Increase the light-theme group-title token contrast and enforce zero serious or critical axe WCAG 2/2.1 A/AA violations in the real Electron renderer.
